articles.title: Burnt out cars and shattered glass on Paris streets after protests turn to riots and looting
articles.description: Around 1,800 people were arrested after nationwide protests saw outbreaks of violence and vandalism.

articles.title: Watch: Parisians wake up to protest damage and looted shops
articles.description: Violence broke out across France on Saturday during the latest day of demonstrations against conditions in schools and the cost of living.

articles.title: Polanski says he will not overturn Green Party's 'Zionism is racism' motion
articles.description: The Green Party leader said, while he wanted to amend it, the motion would stand until 2028.

articles.title: Ending corridor care in hospitals for children a priority, says health secretary
articles.description: Yvette Cooper also announces £140m investment in England's urgent care system, ahead of winter.
